label: Pre-execution-core red baseline
source: Benchmark contracts and the extension regression harness before the execution-core changes.
notes: The child-frame HumanKeys path issues one Controlla.frameHumanTypeCharacter native command per character and re-reads Page.getFrameTree plus full AX state for every character.
The 1000-character transaction test is intentionally red at this commit; it asserts one native transaction, zero warm frame-tree reads, zero AX reads, and zero auto-attach toggles.
These are deterministic local baselines, not installed-Chrome or application qualification.

root_1000_char.framework: Controlla.fastType/humanTypeCharacter previously dispatched per character with an in-page guard before and after each key.

child_frame_1000_char.framework: One native command per character, each revalidating frame tree, AX node, DOM node, focus, and toggling auto-attach.
